deprecated_yaml.description:
The YAML-based Synology SRM device tracker for {host} is deprecated and will be removed in Home Assistant 2027.5. Your existing YAML trackers continue to work until then. To switch to the new integration:

1. Remove the `synology_srm` device tracker platform for this router from `configuration.yaml`. While configured, it keeps adding devices to `known_devices.yaml`.
2. Note the entity IDs of the tracked devices, remove their entries from `known_devices.yaml`, and restart Home Assistant. Keep entries used by other legacy trackers. The legacy entity IDs remain in use until the restart.
3. Set up Synology SRM from **Settings** > **Devices & services**. All devices are initially unselected; select at least one to enable tracking. Unselected devices and devices discovered later remain disabled.
4. If needed, change the entity IDs of the new trackers to the previous IDs to keep existing person assignments and automations working.
deprecated_yaml.title: Migrate Synology SRM device trackers
